web.title: What you can object to, and the time limits | Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# What you can object to, and the time limits
| You can object to | How long you have |
|-|-|
| Assessments | 4 years and one day from the date you were given the assessment. |
| Failures to make an assessment | 60 days, starting 30 days after the date you gave notice requesting an assessment. |
| [Reviewable GST decisions](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?DocID=PAC/19530001/Sch1-110-50&PiT=99991231235958), [reviewable fuel tax decisions](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?DocID=PAC/19530001/Sch1-112-50&PiT=99991231235958) and [reviewable wine tax decisions](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?DocID=PAC/19530001/Sch1-111-50&PiT=99991231235958) | 60 days from the date you were given our decision. |

| You can object to | How long you have |
|-|-|
| Notices about complying fund status or disqualification of an individual from being a trustee | 21 days from the date you were given our decision. |

| You can object to | How long you have |
|-|-|
| Decisions not to remit penalties where the amount owing is more than [2 penalty units](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/paying-the-ato/interest-and-penalties/penalties/penalty-units) | 60 days from the date the decision was given to you. |

| You can object to | How long you have |
|-|-|
| [Reviewable ABN decisions](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?DocID=PAC/19990084/21&PiT=99991231235958) (see [note 2](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/if-you-disagree-with-an-ato-decision/object-to-a-decision/what-you-can-object-to-and-the-time-limits#Note2)) | 60 days from the date you were given our decision. |

| You can object to | How long you have |
|-|-|
| Suspensions, cancellations and refusals regarding licences and claims for remission, rebate, refund or drawback of excise duties | 60 days from the date you were given our decision. |
| Disputed liabilities (amount of duty, rate of duty or liability of goods to duty) | 6 months from the date you deposited the duty. |
| Demands for payment of duty equivalent | 60 days from the date you were given the demand. |

| You can object to | How long you have |
|-|-|
| Assessments and amended assessments | 60 days from the date you were given the assessment. |

| You can object to | How long you have |
|-|-|
| Excise and fuel tax credit private rulings | 60 days from the date you were given the ruling. |
